title: When to label the cartons
passage:
Should I label these cartons before or after we weigh them?
A. The labels are in the lower drawer.
B. The smaller cartons arrived before the others.
C. Wait until I’ve written the weight on each label.
passageZh:
這些紙箱該先貼標籤，還是等我們秤重後再貼？
A. 標籤在下面的抽屜。
B. 小紙箱比其他紙箱早送到。
C. 等我把重量填上每張標籤再貼。
